note: A skill that runs commands the moment it loads: an inline `date` its own `allowed-tools` pre-approves, and a ```! block of git commands. An example inside an ordinary code block is counted too - watched running on a live load - and named apart, because it reads as an example, and `CACHE_KEY=!`...`` is left out, because the documentation says the inline form counts only at a line start or after whitespace.
